title: Gift agreement
paragraphs: Donor: Grant Larceny. Recipient: The Meridian Museum of Art & World Cultures.
1. Naming: The institution shall be renamed The Grant Larceny Meridian Museum.
2. Governance: The donor shall retain approval rights over future acquisitions.
3. Management: Artie Ficial shall tender his resignation within sixty days of acceptance.
annotation: Artie - confirm acceptance before the unveiling. G.L.

records.text: Boardroom telecom recovery: a live call occupied the fixed speakerphone throughout 6:39–6:45 SECURITY time; longest silence fourteen seconds. No forwarding or mobile connection exists. The export withholds caller identity and conversation content. Answering that call supplies an alibi; leaving the line open in an empty room does not.

Board-annex recovery: a live committee connection runs 6:39–6:45 SECURITY time, with the table and sole exit visible continuously. Voting content and participant identity are withheld. Motion seven appears on the agenda; submitting it remotely or leaving an unsigned paper is possible. Remaining at the recorded table is a different claim.

title: Shipping manifest / 1988
annotation: Keep with accession papers. Do not substitute exhibition label for ownership file.

records.text: Registrar vault recovery: an occupied, locked interval runs 6:39–6:45 SECURITY time, with uninterrupted interior video and no other exit. The public extract withholds identity and file contents. A white correction tab can identify a file, not its owner's whereabouts. Working at the outer desk does not place anyone inside the vault.

Library broadcast recovery: live room video runs 6:39–6:45 SECURITY time, continuously covering its speaker and door. Content and identity are withheld. Reading an erratum live in this room is distinct from submitting a correction for the archive to play. A published erratum alone supplies no time or place for its author.

Research cage recovery: occupied enclosure begins 6:39 and ends 6:45 SECURITY time. Interior film is continuous and the room has no second exit. Identity and research content are withheld. Green index tabs are portable stationery; a folder carrying them proves no location. Remaining inside differs from collecting a folder at the outer desk.

title: A warning left behind
paragraphs: RETURN WHAT WAS TAKEN BEFORE THE STAR GOES DARK.

records.text: Return desk recovery: a live teach-in runs 6:39–6:45 SECURITY time. The public stream's uncut wide source includes participant and all exits throughout. Identity and teaching material are withheld. A posted statement, an earlier sticker application or attendance elsewhere in the gallery does not establish participation at this desk during the live stream.

title: GRANT’S NIGHT OF GLORY
paragraphs: Gala programme / press proof. Private toast 6:49. Star Bowl alcove closure 6:48. Unveiling follows the toast.
Printed before the final installation inspection.
Grant Larceny will announce his naming agreement tonight.
annotation: Paige Turner / advance schedule; keep for checking against actual cues.

records.text: Press-booth recovery: a live interview runs 6:39–6:45 SECURITY time. Fixed wall audio and wide camera continuously cover the speaker and exit. Identity and source content are withheld. Moth is a source alias, not an alibi. Posting an edited interview or conducting a mobile conversation elsewhere is not presence in this booth.

Archive-office radio recovery: live fixed-telephone audio runs 6:39–6:45 SECURITY time. No pause exceeds twelve seconds; forwarding is disabled. Identity and discussion content are withheld. An old parcel line can be discussed on any telephone. A mobile call or earlier recorded commentary is distinct from remaining at this archive-office handset.

title: Treatment finding
annotation: Earlier adhesive finding also disputed by donor. Safety takes priority.

records.text: Conservation booth recovery: the occupied purge cycle locks from 6:39–6:45 SECURITY time. Interior video is uninterrupted; the operator works through fixed glove ports. Opening the door aborts the cycle and records an alarm; this cycle has none. Standing beside the booth or starting a cycle from outside supplies no personal alibi.

Freight lift recovery: an occupied cabin is trapped between floors 6:39–6:45 SECURITY time. Continuous cabin video and intercom cover the occupant. Identity and cargo details are withheld. Doors remain locked; the service hatch is bolted outside. Speaking from a loading-bay handset is not speaking from the stranded cabin intercom.

title: Donor agreement / margin copy
paragraphs: The proposed permanent gift remains subject to outstanding provenance review. An accession does not remove competing ownership claims.
annotation: Permanent title does not cure disputed title. S.V.

records.text: Legal-office telecom recovery: a live fixed-line conference runs 6:39–6:45 SECURITY time; longest pause eleven seconds. The line has no remote access. Legal content and caller identity are withheld. A clause nine draft may travel or be dictated earlier. Only participating continuously on this fixed line prevents the salon journey.

Translation booth recovery: a live fixed-microphone session runs 6:39–6:45 SECURITY time. Raw audio has no silence exceeding twelve seconds; continuous video includes the exit. Identity and subject matter are withheld. A custody amendment can be translated before the event. Sending its text or using a mobile phone does not establish booth presence.

title: Auction result
annotation: E.M. beat G.L. through a proxy. He will never forgive this.

records.text: Bid-booth telecom recovery: live fixed-handset conversation runs 6:39–6:45 SECURITY time, without a silence longer than eighteen seconds. That handset cannot connect remotely. Caller identity and sale terms are withheld. A violet reserve entry in an auction file does not establish who answered the call or when it was edited.

Technology stand recovery: a live wired glove session runs 6:39–6:45 SECURITY time. Contact telemetry and uninterrupted room video cover the operator, cable and exit. Identity and demonstration content are withheld. The wireless presentation can run automatically. Starting that presentation or holding a loose controller cannot substitute for this continuous wired session.

Valuation booth recovery: live fixed-line audio runs 6:49–6:55 on the BRASS overlay, with no silence exceeding fifteen seconds. Identity and valuation contents are withheld. The booth has no remote connection. Going twice is ordinary auction language and identifies nobody. A mobile valuation or earlier recorded spiel is not this continuous fixed-line call.

title: Vincent Van Faux
paragraphs: Treasures of the World / Gallery label
annotation: NO. This does not belong in the show.

records.text: Arts-channel recovery: a live portrait session runs 6:39–6:45 SECURITY time. The raw wide camera includes the sitter, painter and door continuously. Faces and painting details are withheld from this extract. A finished picture or prerecorded publicity clip does not place its artist in the studio during this live session.

Portrait station recovery: a camera operator is continuously present 6:49–6:55 BRASS time in uncut behind-camera footage that includes the chair and exits. Identity and photo subjects are withheld. The orange tether cable is visible but stationary. Shutter timestamps, a remote release or a cable left attached do not prove photographer presence.

title: Education reallocation
annotation: Anne E. Dote has not approved these cuts.

records.text: Cash-office CCTV recovery: continuous occupied-room footage covers 6:39–6:45 SECURITY time. Both hands and the only door remain visible; there is no unrecorded exit. Financial details and identity are withheld. A blue audit pencil is portable. Possessing it or altering a voucher elsewhere is not the same as appearing in this office footage.

Style-desk recovery: a live mirror interview runs 6:49–6:55 BRASS time. The uncut wide frame covers participant, chair and exit throughout. Identity and styling content are withheld. A second lipstick is portable and can appear in an earlier photograph. A prerecorded beauty segment or quick retouch does not establish continuous interview presence.

School-link recovery: a live room session runs 6:39–6:45 SECURITY time. Its uncut whole-room feed includes the presenter, puppet and door. Identity and lesson content are withheld. Henri the hippo is a portable teaching prop. A saved puppet film or a puppet resting on a table does not establish who presented this live lesson.

title: Donor Salon camera
annotation: Deliberate disconnection. Not a technical fault.

records.text: North checkpoint recovery: an operator is continuously present 6:39–6:45 SECURITY time; independent CCTV includes the desk, screen and sole exit. Identity and badge details are withheld. The salon camera shutdown at 6:29 does not disable this camera. Delegating checkpoint duty does not place its supervisor at the recorded desk.

Oral-history room recovery: a live interview runs 6:39–6:45 SECURITY time; uninterrupted wide footage covers the seated participant and sole exit. Identity and accession contents are withheld. Box three is an accession container that can be left on a table. Carrying it earlier does not establish participation in the live interview.

Object-study room recovery: an occupied locked session runs 6:39–6:45 SECURITY time. Continuous interior footage covers the occupant; three blue seals remain intact across every service panel. Identity and study object are withheld. A paper left in the corridor gives no alibi. Anyone in this room throughout cannot reach the salon through a panel.

title: Closing reveal / concept
paragraphs: Printed gala credit: The Larceny Foundation.
annotation: The sketch predates the donor’s program credit.

records.text: Performance archive recovery: a live wide shot of the platform runs 6:39–6:45 SECURITY time, continuously showing its occupant, feet and access steps. The projected shadow track can play unattended and proves no one's presence. Red shoes alone identify neither the performer nor the time; distinguish the live platform recording from its projection.

Textile stand recovery: a live loom demonstration runs 6:49–6:55 BRASS time. Uninterrupted wide footage covers the operator, pedals and exits. Identity and textile details are withheld. Repairing gold warp on this live loom requires remaining at the pedals. A finished sample or a demonstration reel can be displayed without its maker present.

Balcony podcast recovery: a live discussion runs 6:49–6:55 BRASS time. Uncut wide video covers speakers, balcony steps and exit throughout. Identity and editorial content are withheld. An unnamed benefactor reference in a released episode is not a location record. An edited or prerecorded podcast can publish without its critic on the balcony.

title: Display proposal / superseded
paragraphs: Enclosed-cabinet proposal dated 20 October. Superseded before installation. Retained with the advance gala papers.

records.text: Rig inspection recovery: an occupied safety harness is fastened at 6:39 and released at 6:45 SECURITY time. The uninterrupted wide film shows the raised platform and access ladder. Identity is withheld. Leaving that harness requires lowering the platform and appears on film. Checking drawings from the floor is not the recorded suspended inspection.

Load-test recovery: an occupied live test runs 6:49–6:55 BRASS time. Wide film continuously includes the platform, hands, feet and exit; force readings respond to the operator. Identity is withheld. A plaster thumb mark on a specimen can predate the test. Automated weights or a remote switch supply no personal alibi.

title: Clock inspection slip
annotation: BRASS-labelled archive overlays inherit this ten-minute error. SECURITY time is correct.

title: Cancelled programme cue
stamp: LIGHTING JOB LOG / NOT SECURITY LOG
annotation: Lighting console does not open or close the security curtain.

records.text: Show-desk recovery: a live manual test runs 6:49–6:55 BRASS time. The manual-contact log matches uninterrupted pink-worklight footage covering hands, feet and both exits. Identity and cue contents are withheld. A saved cue sequence can play automatically; pressing Start and leaving is not continuous manual contact at this desk.

title: Grant Larceny’s toast
paragraphs: 6:40 — sealed clean coupe unwrapped and delivered empty to Donor Salon.
6:44 — transparent service dome closed; numbered seal applied and continuously watched.
6:46 — seal checked intact, dome opened, cordial first poured.
6:49 — private toast; coupe has remained in salon.
annotation: One glass, no substitution. Nothing enters the glass after the dome closes until the witnessed pour.

records.text: Kitchen-pass recovery: an operator remains in the uninterrupted kitchen frame 6:39–6:45 SECURITY time; hands and sole exit stay visible. Identity and tray contents are withheld. A green tray can be carried elsewhere. Empty coupe delivery is independently logged at 6:40; sealing at 6:44 and pouring at 6:46. Those service events identify no kitchen operator.
